Create-family runs stamp every name with KBAB<runId>- and attempt list-delete when the state allows it; residue with visible stamp prefix is otherwise documented in cleanupLog and handed over. This mirrors the 2026-09-07 R1 precedent (8 stamp rows retained).

v1.1 (2026-09-11T03:40+08:00): CEILING TRIGGERED - pilot A-arm 2/2 recorded (traj 723/725, isSuccessful=1) >= 0.9 -> per spec S4 switch difficulty anchors. Difficulty evidence (pre-registered, no post-hoc): stamp family #586/#590/#592/#593/#594 all failed (last actions = legal-rep dialog cancel / list query; fake-success gate '0 persisted steps' verdicts; same-family #595 re-run next day recorded => difficulty was task legs + 09-06 engine state, environment now proven fixed by pilot); #615 credit_usage failed (55 steps, died in guarantee/flow-submit legs). Pilot also proved A-arm completes full create incl. legal-rep import (723/724), so plain create is no longer discriminative: v1.1 difficulty重心 = multi-leg tasks (create + list-verify read-back), rating family (R01/R07 never piloted), rating application initiation (write, revocable), cross-module reads. Kept R06/R09/R11 as within-set easy controls; dropped R08/R10/R12 (same-shape query/no-write, no information); added N01/N02/N03/N04 difficulty anchors. Official 12 = R01,R02,R04,R05,R06,R07,R09,R11,N01,N02,N03,N04 (R12 substitute).

v1.1 (2026-09-11): environmentPrep added to armProtocol: after record/prepare and before record/start, run tmp/kb-ab/close-tianyuan-dialog.py (CDP real-mousedown closes the 天元相关配置 welcome dialog). Applies identically to both arms - harness, not the independent variable. Evidence: page-bind's synthetic footer click cannot close this dialog (same trusted-event class as the mega-menu precedent); agent then pauses per global-dialog guard => zero actions => missing_success_token => traj failed (traj 723 run1). 723 run1 recorded in abortedRuns, excluded from stats; run2 on the same trajectory succeeded.
